title: prelight garland with LED lights
text: prelight garland with LED lights. Wow.  This garland is SUPER garish.  Just over the top.  I chose not to use it.  It was just too much.  I'll figure out something - maybe give it to someone who needs a 'centerpiece' of decor?

product_metadata.title: Valery Madelyn Pre-Lit 6 Feet Traditional Red Green Gold Christmas Garland with 20 LED Lights and Ball Ornaments for Front Door Window Fireplace Mantle Xmas Decor, Battery Operated
features: 【Original Design】Valery Madelyn is a retail brand with original design. The design is inspired by the traditional red green gold Christmas style. The familiar feeling of spending Christmas in the old house at the countryside, with all the pleasant and festive feeling of old traditions

【Very Full & Long Enough】- This 6ft Christmas garland is full of Christmas balls, flowers, berries, pine needles and other rich elements, creating a old traditional scene and bringing festive atmosphere. Matching with our matching wreath is perfect yet easy way

【Exquisite Craftsmanship】- Treated with the latest pressing technology to prevent leaves and pine needles from falling off the garland. This door garland will sustain its original colors and lifelike appearance for years. Note: For better display, please extend the garland when you take them out of the box
【Battery Operated LED Light】 - This lighted garland is 6 hours on, 18 hours off, auto-cycle daily, dimmable with 8 light effects. 3 AA batteries required (not included)

【Application】- This hanging garland length is approx 6 feet/1.83m, suitable to use for front door, wall, fireplace or above the mantle in your house as a warm inviting welcome to your family and friends, also as an excellent gift choice
